place_name: The Stump, Ruth Gorge, Denali NP
approach_stated: From the Ruth Gorge head north or south depending on where your camping, straight toward the Stump ... Navigate a relatively easy section of crevasses
summit_or_glacier: glacier approach (crevasses) from a Ruth Glacier camp; 1800' peak with its own summit

evidence.fact: Peak with its own summit, ~1800 ft off the glacier; approach from Ruth Gorge camp across crevasses.
Choss-o-licious, Stumpjumper, Goldfinger all listed Trad, Alpine.

note: No car access; glacier fly-in. MP calls the glacier approach 'very easy' but it is from a glacier camp, not a car.

place_name: The Gargoyle, Ruth Gorge, Denali NP
approach_stated: Depending where you land on the Ruth Glacier, The Gargoyle is best approached on skies
summit_or_glacier: Ruth Glacier ski approach; 1800' wall capped by a snowfield

evidence.fact: 1800' granite wall capped by a snowfield; approached on skis from the Ruth Glacier landing.
New Mother Nature: Trad, Aid, Alpine, 10 pitches.

approach_stated: From Seward, take Nash road and start bush pushing.
summit_or_glacier: summit routes; Southwest Face is Steep Snow

evidence.fact: Tallest peak in area; hikers summit and summit proper gained with ropes; approach by bush pushing from Nash Road.

note: No time stated; summit/snow peak makes it alpine.
